blocks.text: BRUSSELS — Meghan Markle appeared in public for the first time Tuesday since her estranged father was charged for alleged possession of child sexual abuse images — keeping a low profile as she visited Brussels with her husband Prince Harry. The Duke and Duchess of Sussex were greeted by a cluster of photographers on arrival at the EU parliament for an event about the dangers children face online. Meghan’s father Thomas Markle was arrested in Florida on Friday and charged with one count of possession of child sexual abuse material — and she did not reply to a shouted question seeking […]...
